verdict.rationale: Typesense Cloud's MCP server docs say you decide what the agent is allowed to do when you connect it and can disconnect it at any time. The Cloud support page also lists Role-Based Access Control. Together these give a form of scoped, revocable agent access, but the pack never documents scoped API keys (per-collection or per-action) in the server itself. A 2020 community comment requested index-restricted keys like Algolia's secured keys, which was a gap at that time but is not a concrete contradiction of current behavior. Missing for 10: documented scoped/least-privilege API key creation (actions, collections, expiry), how MCP connection permissions map to credentials, independent or hands-on corroboration.
